name: eevee_material_ao_temporal_sampling
purpose: Verify that the Eevee Ambient Occlusion material node reads the per-sample RNG buffer and converges across rendered temporal samples.
passCriteria: A procedural Suzanne AO scene must contain strong one-sample high-frequency noise, while the 64-sample render must reduce the measured central-region Laplacian energy below 0.06 and below 12 percent of the one-sample energy.
